name: Nana
source:
A beautiful girl who attends the same university as [url=/c145784]Tsumi[/url]. She's very popular among her peers and has a very kind and polite personality, though she also has another secret side to her.

Apparently, she made a promise with Tsumi when they were younger...? 

[From [url=https://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/lipm/character.html]official website[/url]]
